transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... I keep having these moments where it’s like I’m back there. Seeing my cousin on the pavement. The shouting, the lights... it just hits me, even when I’m at the church office trying to act normal.
You mentioned being back there and seeing your cousin on the pavement, are these moments like reliving the experience all over again?

Yeah... it does. It just kind of hits out of nowhere, and suddenly I’m seeing him there on the pavement again. The shouting, the lights... even if I’m just standing in the church office, trying to keep it together.
What usually happens right before these moments when you're back there, reliving the experience?

I don’t always know. It can be nothing, really… I’ll just be at the church office, trying to act normal, and then it’s like the scene is right there again—my cousin on the pavement, the shouting, the lights. It just hits me.
Is there something specific that triggers these moments of reliving the experience?

I don’t know if there’s one specific thing. It just… hits me out of nowhere sometimes. I’ll be at the church office, trying to act normal, and suddenly I can see him on the pavement again, hear the shouting, see the lights.
Do you find yourself avoiding people, places, or things that remind you of what happened to your cousin?

Yeah… I do. I’ll go out of my way sometimes, take the long way so I don’t have to pass the community center or that court. And if people start talking about that night, I usually just… shut it down, or make some excuse to leave.
Do you have trouble sleeping at night?
I… I’m not really sure. Some nights are okay, I guess. I haven’t been paying close attention to it.
Do you often feel on edge or easily startled?

Yeah… I guess I am. I don’t like sitting with my back to a door anymore. At church events I’m… watching people’s hands, the corners, cars slowing down. I’m usually checking where the exits are instead of really listening.
Do you feel guilty about what happened to your cousin?
Yeah… I do. Most days it’s just there, like this weight in my chest. Fear, anger… guilt. Like I failed God, my family… and the kids who trusted me.
How long have you been experiencing these moments of reliving the experience?
Since… since he was killed. About two years and three months now.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy doing?

Yeah. I used to really love preaching, playing keys, taking pictures… playing ball with the guys. Now I either avoid it or just… show up and go through the motions. It doesn’t feel alive in me like it used to.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
Not really. I mean… I still do some of it sometimes—preaching, keys, taking pictures, playing ball—but it’s more like I’m just there. I don’t really look forward to it like I used to.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy and still find pleasure in?

Not really. I mean, I used to love preaching, playing keys, taking pictures… running with the guys on the court. Now it’s mostly just going through the motions, or I avoid it. It doesn’t feel alive like it used to.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or feel motivated to do?
No… not really. I still might preach, play keys, take pictures, maybe run with the guys sometimes, but it’s mostly just… showing up. It doesn’t really feel like anything anymore.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in almost all activities that you used to enjoy?

Yeah… I think so. The stuff I used to love—preaching, playing keys, taking pictures, playing ball—it’s just… I don’t feel much from it now. Most times I’m just going through the motions, or I don’t do it at all.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in almost all activities that once brought you pleasure?

Yeah… I’ve said it already, but yes. Preaching, playing keys, taking pictures, playing ball with the guys… I used to really love that stuff. Now I mostly just go through the motions, or I don’t do it. It doesn’t really feel alive in me anymore.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself?
I’m… not sure how to answer that. I don’t really know how to talk about it.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself since your cousin's death?
I… I don’t know. Since he died, things have been heavy, but… I’m not really ready to get into that.
Have you had any thoughts of harming yourself since your cousin's death?
I hear you asking, but… I still don’t really have an answer I can give. It’s not something I can talk about right now.
